summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.82/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.82 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 8, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 8. AAA figures put the statewide average 31¢ lower than a week ago, 19¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.09 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Janesville ($3.60) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.15).
